invariants.rationale: InputEvent event is passed to the method; typically not expected to be null during a drag event.
Pointer indices in LibGDX input handling are zero-based and non-negative.
The setCursorPosition method is called with x and y (likely related to text position); cursor position is expected to be non-negative.
touchDragged is only called when the actor is touchable in scene2d; thus, isTouchable() should be true at exit.
